name: shine-text
title: Shine Text
description: A band of light glides across the text on a loop, like polished metal catching a lamp.

props.name: baseColor
props.description: Resting text color. Any CSS color.

props.name: shineColor
props.description: Color of the moving highlight. Any CSS color.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the animation off and renders calm static text.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the text element.
